notes.title: Update .140: New face model for Carter!
notes.notes:
Hello folks!

We've been tinkering away on an all-new look for Carter. He didn't really feel like the augmented master hacker he is, so we decided to give him a little make-over. There are two other changes that have been requested by you!

New Additions


 A new text-epiloque screen by the voice of Fore Fathers added after the escape cut scene. (Chapter 5/4 Entry-504)
 A message box to skip a hacking game shown when you fail. (Chapter 2, Alice's Place and Khepra Labs)
 Introduced a new face model for Carter.


New year, new Carter! Take a look at his new face model below.

Let us know what you think of these changes!

notes.title: Update 1.30: sprinting, skipping mini-games, and more!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Thank you for the support you've shown Transient thus far, we're happy to hear that so many of you have enjoyed our adventure. We've also received workable feedback on some aspects of the game that could be improved, and for that, we thank you as well!

This update addresses some of the most common pieces of feedback, including being able to sprint from the start of the game, and skipping mini-games when you lose them.

Changes


 We introduced an option to skip both mini-games (Eldritch and Eryx). With this patch, you can choose to skip both mini-games when getting killed by the enemies.
 You are now able to run when the game begins.
 We introduced various stability improvements and collision fixes along with an improvement for triggering Steam achievements.
 Specifically: collision issues were fixed for the AkeleySubCE level in which the player camera was able to penetrate into some certain walls if players had run onto them.




{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35131902/efe8a6072d2b2f2dbbc056f86084af73e9ae60e6.png
Skippable mini-games.




We've got some more stuff cooking, which we will be revealing soon™. If you got stuck on mini-games before, give Transient another go after updating! We hope you'll enjoy the changes.




Connect with us to stay up to date!

notes.title: Patch v.120 is now available for Transient!
notes.notes:
Thank you all for your amazing feedback! We've listened and would like to share with you the first changes and bugfixes to Transient since its release earlier this week.

Here is a summary of the issues addressed with this patch:

- A Journal entry issue for an important clue corrected in English language.
- A problem with the Motion blur option corrected.
- Focusing issues with the Journal addressed.
- A couple of collision issues corrected.
 
If you encounter bugs or problems, please reach out to us on one of the channels listed below.

notes.title: Exact release date reveal at The MIX Next TODAY!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Around Gamescom, we announced that Transient would be releasing in October, and that's still the case. And now that we're getting closer and closer to release, we can finally share the exact release date at the MIX Next event!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35131902/52cc5505d810782a54211eb3dd832727b82f6711.jpg

In case you're unfamiliar, The MIX Next is an online event showcasing the hottest upcoming indies, and we're honored to be a part of that. Transient will be part of the main show, which starts on October 14th around 11 AM PT / 8 PM CEST. 

Catch it live on the Indie Media Exchange Twitch channel!

Time zones are silly things, so you can check the sidebar on the right to see the exact start time converted to your time zone.

Hope to see you there!

Connect with us to stay up to date!

notes.title: Transient release window reveal at Gamescom!
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone.

We're excited to announce... an announcement! 

This Gamescom, we'll be revealing our release window via IGN and Iceberg Ahead. Of course, due to circumstances, the show will be completely online -- and free! That means it's never been easier to tune in to Gamescom and follow your favorite gaming news.

Our brand new trailer, along with the release window, will be revealed via a new trailer on IGN on August 28th-- be there, or be an eldritch square.
